name: FOXP3 60kb hi-res (200bp, Treg H3K27ac + Tconv CTCF)
description: Focused 60kb window spanning FOXP3 CTCF-to-CTCF sub-TAD (chrX:49235000-49295000, GRCh38). Resolution 200bp, 300 bins — maximum resolution — comparable to HBB 95kb sub-TAD (159 bins at 600bp). CTCF sites from human resting Tconv ChIP-seq (GSM9161596, Donor 1, MACS3). Enhancers from human resting Treg H3K27ac ChIP-seq (GSM9177365, Donor 1, MACS3). Data from Umhoefer et al., Immunity 59(1):129-144, 2026. DOI: 10.1016/j.immuni.2025.10.020.
